QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Pin the Brooch on Delilah
QuestInfo.1: Time to return the heartbeat sensor to Delilah over at #bFunky Station <2>#k.
QuestInfo.2: You put the heartbeat sensor back on #bDelilah#k who, for some reason, does not question Dylan's insistence that she wear it.

0.0: We were too slow. Delilah's heart rate has already dropped back down. We need to hurry to the next phase of my brilliant plan! But to do that, we need that sensor on her. \nSee what you can do, #e#h0##n!
